```{r Load clean_names_lowercase function}
clean_names_lowercase <- function(x) {
  x <- iconv(x, from = "", to = "UTF-8", sub = "")
  x <- stringi::stri_trans_general(x, "Latin-ASCII")
  x %>%
    tolower() %>%
    trimws()
}
```

# NP Final Scores ------------------------------

```{r Load in Sub-Scores}
# Fish oil fish meal (FOFM)
FOFM_SubScores0<- read.csv("/home/ferrer/ohi_goc_prep/NP/v2026/NP_Scores_1.1/FOFM_Scores_1.1/FOFM_SubScores_df_Oct192026.csv")
FOFM_SubScores<- FOFM_SubScores0

# Ornamental species (ORNA)
ORNA_SubScores0<- read.csv("/home/ferrer/ohi_goc_prep/NP/v2026/NP_Scores_1.1/ORNA_Scores_1.1/ORNA_SubScores_df_Oct192026.csv")
ORNA_SubScores<- ORNA_SubScores0

# Fisheries residues (RESD)
RESD_SubScores0<- read.csv("/home/ferrer/ohi_goc_prep/NP/v2026/NP_Scores_1.1/RESD_Scores_1.1/RESD_SubScores_df_Oct192026.csv")
RESD_SubScores<- RESD_SubScores0

# Coastal mining production (MINE)
MINE_SubScores0<- read.csv("/home/ferrer/ohi_goc_prep/NP/v2026/NP_Scores_1.1/MINE_Scores_1.1/MINE_SubScores_df_Oct192026.csv")
MINE_SubScores<- MINE_SubScores0
```

# Merge ---

```{r Prep dataframes for merging}
# Fish oil fish meal (FOFM)
colnames(FOFM_SubScores)

FOFM_SubScores_simple<- FOFM_SubScores %>%
  select(rgn_name, rgn_id, year, FOFM_score, FOFM_include= region_exclude_include)


# Ornamental species (ORNA)
colnames(ORNA_SubScores)

ORNA_SubScores_simple<- ORNA_SubScores %>%
  select(rgn_name, rgn_id, year, ORNA_score, ORNA_include= region_exclude_include)


# Fisheries residues (RESD)
colnames(RESD_SubScores)

RESD_SubScores_simple<- RESD_SubScores %>%
  select(rgn_name, rgn_id, year, RESD_score, RESD_include= region_exclude_include)


# Coastal mining production (MINE)
colnames(MINE_SubScores)

MINE_SubScores_simple<- MINE_SubScores %>%
  select(rgn_name, rgn_id, year, MINE_score)

```

```{r Merge Component Scores}
NP_Scores0 <- list(
  FOFM_SubScores_simple,
  ORNA_SubScores_simple,
  RESD_SubScores_simple,
  MINE_SubScores_simple
) %>%
  reduce(full_join, by = c("year", "rgn_id", "rgn_name"))
```

```{r Filter out "exclude" values and 2018-2024}
NP_Scores <- NP_Scores0 %>%
  mutate(
    FOFM_score = if_else(FOFM_include == "exclude", NA_real_, FOFM_score),
    ORNA_score = if_else(ORNA_include == "exclude", NA_real_, ORNA_score),
    RESD_score = if_else(RESD_include == "exclude", NA_real_, RESD_score)
  )

NP_Scores<- NP_Scores %>%
  filter(!is.na(rgn_id)) %>%
  filter(year >= 2018, year <= 2024)
# 63 obs., 10 vars.
```

```{r Calculate NP_Scores}
colnames(NP_Scores)

NP_Scores <- NP_Scores %>%
  mutate(
    NP_Score = rowMeans(
      select(., FOFM_score, ORNA_score,
                    RESD_score, MINE_score),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    NP_Score= round(NP_Score, 2),
    
    NP_Score_n_components = rowSums(
      !is.na(select(., FOFM_score, ORNA_score,
                    RESD_score, MINE_score))
    )
  )

dim(NP_Scores)
# 63 obs., 12 vars.

```

## SAVE NP_Scores
```{r SAVE NP_Scores}
write.csv(
  NP_Scores,
  file= "/home/ferrer/ohi_goc_prep/NP/v2026/NP_Scores_1.1/NP_Scores_1.1_df_Oct192026.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

```{r Sanity check final NP_Scores}
colnames(NP_Scores)

summary(NP_Scores$NP_Score)

# AFTER FINAL ADJUSTMENTS FOLLOWING EWG 3.2:
   # Min. 1st Qu.  Median    Mean 3rd Qu.    Max.    NA's 
   # 0.75   15.16   42.84   41.25   63.67  100.00      28 

# Year 2024 mean for NP_Scores:
mean(NP_Scores$NP_Score[NP_Scores$year == 2024], na.rm = TRUE)
# 29

# Calculate regional means (hard to tell given how bouncy):
colnames(NP_Scores)

NP_regional_mean_scores<- NP_Scores %>%
  select(rgn_id, NP_Score, NP_Score_n_components) %>%
  group_by(rgn_id) %>%
    summarize(
      NP_regional_score= mean(NP_Score, na.rm= TRUE),
      NP_regional_score_components= mean(NP_Score_n_components, na.rm= TRUE)
    )
```

# Plot final NP_Scores:

```{r Load in NP_Scores as needed}
NP_Scores0<- read.csv("/home/ferrer/ohi_goc_prep/NP/v2026/NP_Scores_1.1/NP_Scores_1.1_df_Oct192026.csv")
# 63 obs., 12 vars.

NP_Scores<- NP_Scores0
```

```{r Merge Region_Key to NP_Scores}
# Make sure to order the regions:
region_order <- c(
  "Western Upper Gulf",
  "Western Midriff Islands",
  "Western Central Gulf",
  "Western Southern Gulf",
  "Eastern Upper Gulf",
  "Eastern Midriff Islands",
  "Southern Sonora Coast",
  "Sinaloa Coast",
  "Southeastern Gulf"
)

NP_Scores <- NP_Scores %>%
  mutate(
    rgn_name = factor(
      rgn_name,
      levels = region_order
    )
  )
```

```{r Plot NP_Scores over time by region}
Region_colors<- c(
  "Western Upper Gulf" = "#C03729",
  "Western Midriff Islands" = "#E68C7C",
  "Western Central Gulf" = "#FC8F24",
  "Western Southern Gulf" = "#dcaa38",
  "Eastern Upper Gulf" = "#cbd2a0",
  "Eastern Midriff Islands" = "#98a25a",
  "Southern Sonora Coast" = "#747428",
  "Sinaloa Coast" = "#627391",
  "Southeastern Gulf" = "#8d61a9")

# Plot over time:
NP_Scores_OverTime <- NP_Scores %>%
  filter(!is.na(rgn_id)) %>%
  
  ggplot(aes(x = year, 
             y = NP_Score, 
             color = rgn_name)) +
  
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  
  facet_wrap(~ rgn_name, scales = "fixed") +
  
  labs(
    title = "NP Scores by Region",
    subtitle= "The mean of FOFM, ORNA, RESD, and MINE scores", 
    caption = "updated: Oct 19 2026",
    y = "NP Current Status (0 to 100)",
    x = "Year"
  ) +
  
  ylim(c(0, 101)) +
  
  geom_hline(yintercept = 100, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  
  scale_color_manual(values = Region_colors) +
  
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold")
  )

NP_Scores_OverTime
```
